title: English Practice Quiz 0711
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: At 8 p.m. yesterday, I ___ dinner.
questions.explanation: Use the past continuous for an action in progress at a specific past time.

questions.question: Choose the opposite of 'polite'.
questions.explanation: Rude is the opposite of polite.

questions.question: I saw ___ elephant at the zoo.
questions.explanation: Use an before a vowel sound.

questions.question: The hospital is ___ the bank and the post office.
questions.explanation: Between is used for a position separating two things.

questions.question: Choose the correct plural of 'child'.
questions.explanation: Children is the irregular plural of child.

questions.question: Which word has the /ʃ/ sound as in 'ship'?
You have completed a task. You say:
questions.explanation: The task is complete is a clear status update.

questions.question: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence.
questions.explanation: Start with a capital letter and use a question mark.

questions.question: The bus is ___ than the car today.
questions.explanation: Use the comparative form faster when comparing two things.
